notes.title: Games From Ontario Steam Event
notes.content:
We're excited to be a part of the Games from Ontario Steam event! 

Starting today, celebrate Ontario game development with a full week of livestreams and discounts! There's over 200 games participating in the event including our upcoming game Rocket Rumble! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35307218/a6ca85468d664b5309e12152ae1b155763747008.png

PixelNAUTS Games is proud to be Canadian and we feel super lucky that there's such an amazing game development community in our home province! So kick back and enjoy a week of Ontario-made games! 


-PixelNAUTS Games
